_why: The premade build reaches Runic Power Mastery but stops at tier 5, so it
buys none of the tier-6 row -- which is where the entire Frost redesign
lives. This build buys all three:
Chilblains 3/3               (T6.0) Frost Fever victims are Chilled, and
Frost Fever ticking on a Chilled target
drains health to you. This is the loop, and
it needs both halves up, which is why the
rotation keeps Icy Touch at disease-upkeep
priority rather than treating it as filler.
Hungering Cold 1/1           (T6.1) a 10-yard freeze that applies Frost
Fever and drains health on thaw. The
emergency version of the same mechanic.
Improved Frost Presence 2/2  (T6.2) free presence swaps, less damage
taken, and the armour bonus retained in the
other presences.
Runic Power Mastery 2/2 is already in the premade build and is the other
half of the sustain: spending runic power restores health, so Frost Strike
is a heal rather than a dump.
Funded by rebuilding the 18-point Unholy dip into 12. What goes is the part
that needs a ghoul or a second disease application:
Hungry Dead 3/3        ghouls deal 10% more damage per disease. Frost has
no permanent ghoul -- Master of Ghouls is Unholy.
Necrosis 5/5           shadow damage on auto-attacks. Real throughput,
and the cheapest 5 points to give up for a talent
row that is pure survivability.
Blood-Caked Blade 3/3  extra strikes; goes with Necrosis.
What replaces them is Anticipation 5/5, which is dodge, and which the dip
needs anyway: Epidemic sits in tier 1 and cannot be reached without 5 points
in tier 0, so the dip cannot simply be made smaller. Epidemic 2/2 stays --
disease duration is Chilblains uptime.
59 Frost / 12 Unholy.
